items.title: This might be the real reason Elon Musk says Tesla’s AI5 chip is going to Optimus
items.raw_content: Elon Musk says Tesla’s cars don’t need the next-generation AI5 chip, so it’s going to Optimus first. A new report from Taiwan’s chip supply chain gives a more practical reason: Tesla won’t have enough AI5 chips for its cars until 2028. According to Commercial Times , Tesla’s chip design partner Global Unichip (GUC) is giving its limited TSMC 3nm capacity for 2027 to Google and Microsoft data center chips first. That leaves Tesla with a relatively small AI5 allocation. more…
items.title_zh: 马斯克称 AI5 芯片优先给 Optimus，真正原因可能是台积电 3nm 产能
items.summary: Elon Musk says Tesla's cars don't need the next-generation AI5 chip, so it is going to Optimus first; Taiwan's Commercial Times reports Tesla won't have enough AI5 chips for cars until 2028 because design partner GUC is allocating limited TSMC 3nm capacity to Google and Microsoft data-center chips first.
